component.name: ShareX
component.summary: Screen capture, file sharing and productivity tool

description.p: ShareX is a free and open source program that lets you capture or record any area of your screen and share it with a single keypress. It also allows uploading images, text or other types of files to many supported destinations and can be used as a productivity tool.

ul.li: Fullscreen, active window, active monitor, region and scrolling screen capture
Screen recording to MP4, WebM, MKV or animated GIF, with system audio, microphone and camera
Annotation editor with shapes, arrows, text, blur, pixelate, highlight and image insert
Upload to file hosts, FTP/SFTP/WebDAV, S3, Azure, custom uploaders (.sxcu) and URL shorteners
Workflows and hotkeys, watch folders, image effects (.sxie) and after-capture/after-upload tasks
History, QR codes, OCR, colour picker, ruler, hash checker, image and video tools

description.p: This build runs natively on Linux (Wayland and X11) and uses the desktop's own facilities for screen capture, recording, clipboard access, notifications and global hotkeys.
First natively packaged Linux build: Wayland/X11 screen capture and recording, Linux clipboard, notifications, hotkeys, uploaders and history.
